articles.제목: Regulatory milestone for US laser enrichment plant
articles.원문 요약: The US regulator has issued its Final Environmental Impact Statement for Global Laser Enrichment's Paducah Laser Enrichment Facility, recommending that a construction and operation licence is issued for the proposed plant.

articles.제목: Studsvik's waste treatment technology heads to Fukushima
articles.원문 요약: Swedish nuclear technical services provider Studsvik is to provide Japanese nuclear engineering start-up ReNu Industries Inc with technical information and advice on design conditions for a Japanese version of inDRUM, its patented technology for the treatment of problematic radioactive wastes.

articles.제목: First reactor unit launched on Chukotka icebreaker
articles.원문 요약: The starboard reactor unit on the new Chukotka nuclear-powered icebreaker has been brought to minimum controlled power level.

articles.제목: Preparations for advanced nuclear at ports should begin now, study concludes
articles.원문 요약: Ports should begin structured planning for advanced nuclear technology now, treating it as a long-term infrastructure and operating-model question rather than a new marine fuel, according to a new joint paper from the British Ports Association and Lloyd's Register.
